notes:
- Fixed players getting immediately kicked (~12s) right after joining a lobby when Steam P2P took longer to connect or dropped a relay route (lobby-relayed keepalive heartbeats + extended Steam connection headroom, coopnative v0.8.5)
- Fixed Steam P2P channel stalls (eResult=35) by properly closing & auto-restarting failed sessions in both in-process coopnative.dll and standalone SteamBridge.exe
- Fixed mid-game disconnects during brief network blips (relaxed peer/host timeouts to 30s/35s and removed aggressive 4.5s drop on transient relay hiccups)
- Fixed mid-game ghost-peer desync after temporary timeouts: returning players now transparently re-attach to their existing peer slot with full two-way sync instead of turning into an unresponsive ghost peer
- Suppressed trailing in-flight packets after clean player leave so phantom peers are no longer spawned
